# 04 Lay out a core class diagram

## Outcome

`layoutClassDiagram` measures each class box from its own lines — name, optional annotation, and
every member — sizes the box to the widest line and the summed height, records each compartment's
divider position, measures relationship labels and multiplicity, and gets coordinates from
`layoutDirectedGraph`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A two-class, one-relationship model returns a `PositionedClassDiagram` with a box per class
  whose `width` fits its widest measured line and whose `height` covers name plus every member
  line plus padding.
- [ ] A class with both attributes and methods records a divider y between the name and the
  attributes, and another between the attributes and the methods; a class with only a name records
  no dividers.
- [ ] Each member line carries its own y within the box, in declaration order, attributes before
  methods.
- [ ] Each relationship carries a point path between its two class boxes, plus a label anchor when
  it has a label and one anchor per multiplicity string, positioned near the respective end.
- [ ] `direction` maps to the shared core's `rankdir`: the same model laid out `LR` and `TB`
  produces different class positions.
- [ ] The returned `width`/`height` bound every class box, relationship path and label.
- [ ] Uses the same `TextMeasurer` seam as the other layouts — tests use a deterministic fake.

## Test seam

`layoutClassDiagram(model: ClassModel, options: { measureText: TextMeasurer }): PositionedClassDiagram`
— unit level, pure function, fake measurer, hand-built `ClassModel` fixtures.
